title: EtherChannel
description: Build a complete EtherChannel bundle and verify load balancing and redundancy.
scenario: Build a complete EtherChannel bundle and verify load balancing and redundancy.

concepts.title: What is EtherChannel?
concepts.body: EtherChannel bundles up to 8 physical links into one logical port-channel. STP treats the bundle as a single link, so all member links forward traffic.
concepts.code:
Fa0/1 + Fa0/2 → Port-channel 1 (Po1)
STP sees ONE link, not two

concepts.title: Configuration Steps
concepts.body: 1) Enter interface range. 2) Set matching speed/duplex/VLAN/trunk. 3) Create the channel-group. The Po interface is created automatically.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface range FastEthernet0/1-2
SW1(config-if-range)# channel-group 1 mode active

concepts.title: Load Balancing
concepts.body: Traffic is distributed across member links based on a hash: src-mac, dst-mac, src-dst-mac, src-ip, dst-ip, or src-dst-ip.

concepts.title: Verifying EtherChannel
concepts.body: "show etherchannel summary" shows Po1(SU) — S = Layer2, U = in use. (P) next to a port means it is bundled in the channel.
concepts.code:
SW1# show etherchannel summary
1      Po1(SU)     LACP      Fa0/1(P) Fa0/2(P)
